Meet Josh “OG” Bannerman, CFP®

Helping clients turn financial knowledge into better decisions.

Josh Bannerman founded Bannerman Wealth to help people move beyond scattered financial decisions and into a more coordinated advisory relationship.

With more than 25 years of experience in financial planning, investment planning, and entrepreneurship, Josh believes advice should be objective, practical, and built around real life.

Josh’s approach

Objective advice, made easier to act on.

  • •2012 co-founded the podcast with Joe Saul-Sehy as “OG”
  • •40M+ downloads across the show’s history
  • •15 yrs on the air as a personal finance show
  • •2× Plutus Award winner

Josh believes everyone deserves objective, unbiased advice. That belief led him to start Bannerman Wealth, a firm focused on comprehensive planning, investment guidance, and clearer decision-making for clients across the country.

His work centers on helping clients connect investments, taxes, retirement, risk, estate decisions, and family priorities into one coordinated planning relationship. Planning should help clients understand what matters, what connects, and which decisions deserve attention first.

Built outside the big-box model

Bannerman Wealth was designed to give clients a more personal, planning-centered advisory experience.

Focused on useful education

Josh, known to listeners as “OG,” co-founded the Stacking Benjamins podcast in 2012 with Joe Saul-Sehy, reflecting his belief that financial education should be accessible, useful, and engaging.

Outside the office

Michigan roots, family, service, and a full life.

Josh has deep roots in Michigan and spent the early part of his advisory career in Ann Arbor and Farmington Hills before building Bannerman Wealth as a virtual firm serving clients across the country.

Service is a major part of his personal story. His family has a long military history, and Josh served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1996 to 2002. He credits the Marines with helping shape his confidence, discipline, decisiveness, integrity, and belief that he can accomplish whatever he puts his mind to.

Josh is married to his wife, Lissa, and they have three children: Alex, William, and Caroline. When he’s not creating solutions for clients, you can find him golfing, flying his Cirrus airplane, relaxing with family in Houghton Lake, or officiating college football.
